entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: The God of Deception on Theros, governing gambling, lies, betrayal and secrets, and the first of the Returned.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of death and the Underworld who despises Phenax for cheating death and conspires to bury his secret.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God of death and the Underworld whose tattered cloak Phenax wore to cross back to the living world.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god of law, order and justice whom Phenax holds in contempt.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: A god of law and order whom Phenax holds in contempt.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: The now-destroyed god of revels whose apotheosis Phenax covertly supported.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A nightmare planeswalker who made a pact with Phenax.

entities.name: Tymaret
entities.description: Erebos's agent, whose loyal Returned refuse to acknowledge Phenax's godhood.

entities.name: Xandria
entities.description: A woman strongly implied to have been transformed into a siren by Phenax's curse after falling in love with Ninis.

entities.name: Ninis
entities.description: A mortal Phenax had taken an interest in, loved by Xandria.

entities.name: Returned
entities.description: The undead who have escaped the Underworld, for whom Phenax is progenitor and patron.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane on which Phenax is a god.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: The realm of the dead from which Phenax escaped.

entities.name: Iretis
entities.description: A polis Phenax agreed to help Ashiok lay waste to, creating a new home for the Returned.

entities.name: Asphodel
entities.description: A necropolis where Phenax is openly worshiped.

entities.name: Odunos
entities.description: A necropolis where Phenax is openly worshiped.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: A period that prevented the gods of Theros from influencing mortal affairs.

events.summary: Originally a mortal trapped in the Underworld, Phenax hides from Erebos and Athreos by forsaking his identity and crosses back wrapped in Athreos's cloak, becoming the first Returned.
events.quote: This escape established his role as the first Returned and set him on the path to godhood.

events.summary: Phenax covertly supports Xenagos's apotheosis to subvert divine authority.
Phenax makes a pact with Ashiok to lay waste to Iretis in exchange for hiding Ashiok from the other gods.
events.quote: Phenax made a pact with the nightmare planeswalker Ashiok

events.summary: The Silence of the Gods prevents Phenax from influencing mortal affairs.
events.quote: which prevented him from influencing mortal affairs during that period

events.summary: Phenax is strongly implied to have cursed Xandria, turning her into a siren after she fell in love with Ninis.
events.quote: It is also strongly implied that Phenax was the god behind the curse

events.summary: According to a rarely whispered tale, Phenax was destined to free the Titans, so mortals killed him and the gods later allowed his escape.
events.quote: the gods later allowed his escape to protect themselves

relations.note: Erebos despises Phenax for cheating death
relations.quote: gods of death and the Underworld, despise Phenax for cheating death and escaping their grasp
